parameters.name: Net
parameters.description: The CIDR block of the anti-DDoS diversion instance.

parameters.name: Regions
parameters.description:
The regions in which the CIDR block needs to be advertised or withdrawn from advertising. If you leave this parameter empty, the CIDR blocks in all regions are configured.

>  You can call the [QueryNetList](~~2639086~~) operation to obtain the regions of the CIDR blocks.

parameters.name: SaleId
parameters.description: The ID of the anti-DDoS diversion instance.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the CIDR block. Valid values:

*   enable: advertises the CIDR block.
*   disable: withdraws the advertising of the CIDR block.

parameters.name: SubNets
parameters.description: The subnet CIDR blocks of the CIDR block.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddosdiversion config-net-status --sale-id ddos_diversion_public_cn-xxxxxxxxxxxxx --net 192.168.XX.XX/22 --status enable --regions oe26 --sub-nets 192.168.XX.XX/24 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ddosdiversion ConfigNetStatus --region cn-hangzhou --Status enable --SubNets.1 '192.168.XX.XX/24' --Regions.1 oe26 --SaleId 'ddos_diversion_public_cn-xxxxxxxxxxxxx' --Net '192.168.XX.XX/22' --method POST --force
